indication_label: Paediatric and young adult (up to 25 y) B-cell ALL refractory, in relapse post-transplant or in second or later relapse
verbatim: Applying this estimate results in an annual eligible population for treatment with tisagenlecleucel of 400 patients.
source_doc: ICER, Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-Cell Therapy for B-Cell Cancers: Effectiveness and Value, Final Evidence Report, 23 March 2018
notes: Derivation (p.65-66): 2017 US ALL incidence 5,970 (SEER); under-25 cohort 3,651 (all under 20 plus 50% of 20-34); 82.5% B-ALL = 3,012; 3% refractory to initial therapy, 20% relapse; of relapsers 15% refractory to 2L and 36.5% relapse on 2L; result 400 per year.

indication_label: Paediatric and young adult r/r B-cell ALL (ICER executive summary budget-impact table)
verbatim: Table ES21. Estimated Annualized Total Potential Budget Impact (BI) of Tisagenlecleucel Using Different Prices Over a Five-year Time Horizon, Assuming 617 Eligible Patients per Year
source_doc: ICER, Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-Cell Therapy for B-Cell Cancers: Effectiveness and Value, Final Evidence Report, 23 March 2018
notes: Internal inconsistency in the ICER report: executive-summary Table ES21 title assumes 617 eligible per year while the body text derives 400 per year. Treat 400-617 as the ICER range.

indication_label: All ALL, US, all ages (denominator used by ICER)
unit: new cases per year (count, not rate)

source_doc: ICER, Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-Cell Therapy for B-Cell Cancers: Effectiveness and Value, Final Evidence Report, 23 March 2018
notes: Count not rate. ICER then takes 3,651 under age 25 and 82.5% B-lineage = 3,012 B-ALL under 25 per year: 'Of the 3,651 remaining ALL patients, we estimated that 82.5% would have B-ALL (3,012 patients).'

indication_label: ALL diagnosed at age 20 and younger, US; share who could benefit from Kymriah

source_doc: The Motley Fool, 'Novartis' $475,000 Price Tag Sets the Stage for a Price War With Gilead Sciences' (31 Aug 2017), reporting Novartis statements
notes: Arithmetic: 3,100 x 15% = 465; 3,100 x 20% = 620. The 3,100 and 15-20% are read in the secondary article (Novartis attribution); Novartis' own 30 Aug 2017 approval release (fetched) gives no patient count. A search summary also paraphrased 'about 600 would be considered candidates'.

indication_label: Adult r/r DLBCL (incl. transplant-ineligible and post-ASCT relapse) after 2 or more lines of systemic therapy

notes: Derivation p.66: DLBCL incidence 27,650 (2016, Teras et al.); 35% r/r = 9,678; 50% transplant-ineligible (4,839) of which 49% (2,371) failed salvage and eligible; transplant-eligible 4,839: 2,371 (49%) failed salvage plus 1,160 (47% of ASCT recipients not cured). ICER adds: 'we have not taken into consideration the current annual axicabtagene ciloleucel manufacturing capacity of 4,000 to 5,000 treatments per year.'

indication_label: DLBCL, US, all patients (denominator used by ICER)
unit: new cases per year (count, not rate)

source_doc: ICER, Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-Cell Therapy for B-Cell Cancers: Effectiveness and Value, Final Evidence Report, 23 March 2018
notes: Count not rate. ICER: 'We assumed that 35% of all DLBCL patients relapsed or were refractory to chemotherapy' giving 9,678 r/r DLBCL per year.

indication_label: r/r DLBCL after first-line and salvage (US, all r/r DLBCL before fitness filters)

source_doc: ICER, Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-Cell Therapy for B-Cell Cancers: Effectiveness and Value, Final Evidence Report, 23 March 2018
notes: Intermediate ICER figure (35% of 27,650). Upper bound for any 2L+ CAR-T-eligible estimate in the US.

indication_label: 3L+ DLBCL patients in SEER-Medicare (aged 65+, fee-for-service Medicare), 2017-2020
unit: patients per year (Medicare SEER areas only)

source_doc: Blood Advances 2025, 'Inequalities in CAR T-cell therapy access for US patients with relapsed/refractory DLBCL: a SEER-Medicare data analysis' (PMC12466227)
notes: Arithmetic: 2,241 / 4 years = 560 per year, restricted to SEER-Medicare coverage (about a third of the US population, aged 65+). The fetch summary also paraphrased 'approximately 987 Medicare patients annually receive third-line or later therapy ... 6.3% of the roughly 15,673 total DLBCL cases'; those two numbers were not read verbatim and may belong to PMC12804711 (US claims study) instead.

indication_label: Adult r/r DLBCL, US claims-based incidence and share reaching 3L

source_doc: Search-result snippet attributed to 'Real-world treatment patterns and clinical outcomes among patients with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma in a US healthcare claims database' (PMC12804711) or PMC12466227
notes: Snippet only; article not fetched. Implies 987 patients per year reach 3L on this base (4.68 per 100,000 x US population). A second snippet in the same search stated 'approximately 22,000 new diagnoses of DLBCL in the United States each year'.

indication_label: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and PMBCL after 2 or more systemic therapies (NICE TA872, routine commissioning)

indication_label: LBCL needing second-line treatment, US (all 2L, before the refractory/early-relapse restriction)
source_doc: Derived from the Kite boilerplate above
notes: Arithmetic: 18,000 x 0.30 = 5,400; 18,000 x 0.40 = 7,200. Upper bound for the ZUMA-7 label population, which excludes relapses after 12 months and transplant-unfit patients.

notes: Same release: 'Although 60% of newly diagnosed LBCL patients, including those with DLBCL, will respond to their initial treatment, 40% will relapse or will not respond and need second-line treatment.' 'Up to' 38,000 is an upper bound.

indication_label: LBCL needing second-line treatment, Europe (all 2L)
source_doc: Derived from the Gilead 17 Oct 2022 release
notes: Arithmetic: 38,000 x 40% = 15,200 per year (upper bound; 'up to 38,000').

indication_label: Erwachsene mit DLBCL oder HGBL, das innerhalb von 12 Monaten nach Abschluss einer Erstlinien-Chemoimmuntherapie rezidiviert oder gegenüber dieser refraktär ist, und für die eine Hochdosistherapie infrage kommt

indication_label: Follicular lymphoma, US, all new cases (denominator; label is r/r FL after 2 or more lines)
unit: new cases per year (count, not rate)
verbatim: An estimated incidence of 3.4 per 100,000 population (from 2011 to 2012) translates to about 13,960 new cases per year in the United States.
source_doc: Search snippet from 'Investigation of the incidence trend of follicular lymphoma from 2008 to 2017 in Taiwan and the United States using population-based data' (PMC8929617)
notes: Snippet only. No estimate of the 3L+ FL population eligible for CAR-T in the US was found for Breyanzi, Kymriah or Yescarta.

indication_label: Mantle cell lymphoma, US, all new cases (denominator; label is r/r MCL after 2 or more lines including a BTK inhibitor)
unit: new cases per year (count, not rate)
verbatim: as of 2020, the incidence per 1,000,000 was 10.83 for the general population, which translates to approximately 3,500-3,800 new cases annually in the U.S.
source_doc: Search-result snippet, ASH 2023 abstract (Blood 142 Suppl 1: 6165)
notes: Snippet only; see Tecartus MCL rows for England (110) and Germany (105-150), which share the post-BTKi MCL population.

indication_label: Adults (18+) with relapsed or refractory B-cell precursor ALL (US label); adult ALL new cases as denominator
unit: new cases per year (count, not rate)
verbatim: according to the American Cancer Society is predicted to affect approximately 6,500 adults in the United States in 2023.
source_doc: Autolus Therapeutics plc Form 10-K for FY2024
notes: Filing date taken as March 2025 from the accession number; day not verified.

indication_label: Adult ALL patients who relapse, US (arithmetic on Autolus 10-K statements)
verbatim: Approximately 50% of all adult ALL patients will relapse
source_doc: Autolus Therapeutics plc Form 10-K for FY2024
notes: Arithmetic: 6,500 x 50% = 3,250 relapsed adult ALL per year; excludes primary refractory patients and does not subtract those unfit for CAR-T. The 10-K gives no explicit addressable-population figure.

indication_label: Adult ALL, US and EU combined: new cases and relapsed/refractory patients per year (Autolus corporate materials)
verbatim: Approximately 8,400 new cases of adult ALL are diagnosed every year in the US and EU, with around 3,000 patients in the relapsed refractory setting.
source_doc: Autolus corporate presentation / investor materials (search-result summary; exact document not retrieved)
notes: Snippet only; the 8,400 incident cases is a combined US+EU figure. Applies equally to the Tecartus adult ALL population.

indication_label: Relapsed or refractory B-cell precursor ALL in adults 26 years and over (NICE TA1116)
verbatim: The eligible population is estimated to be around 50 people.
source_doc: NICE TA1116 resource impact summary report (11 December 2025)
notes: Page retrieved by curl. Lower than the TA893 brexu-cel figure (90) for the same population two years earlier. NICE guidance (NCBI NBK620353) adds: 'around 22.5% of people having tisagenlecleucel in the NHS are aged 18 to 25 years'. G-BA and HAS assessments of obe-cel were not located before the search budget ran out.
